title: Gate portable container exports on core and renderer regression suites
changes: Run input/config, menu, core, screen and runtime tests serially in both container recipes before exporting portable artifacts. This includes panel-bound equivalence and surface-recovery tests and respects shared core display globals.
validation: Windows Docker cross-build/Wine passed 306 tests: 164 core, 26 input/config, 33 menu, 45 runtime and 38 screen. Eight optional cases stayed ignored. Exported ZIP passed CRC, private-data exclusions, production-marker and BUILD-INFO SHA-256 checks.

Linux Docker passed 307 tests: 164 core, 26 input/config, 33 menu, 44 runtime and 40 screen. Eight optional cases stayed ignored. Exported tar.gz passed integrity, executable-mode, private-data exclusion, production-marker and BUILD-INFO SHA-256 checks.
limitations: Optional local-ROM, GPU readback and microbenchmark cases remain ignored in the default recipes; native GPU, physical controllers and native Windows require separate validation.
